messages:
maria: FYI console is showing 200ms spikes when loading tenant with ~700 routes + entitlements. reproducible in staging.

liam: seen it. large entitlement matrices blow up front-end render? or backend list API hot loops?

josh: backend call returns entire grant graph; our client does O(n^2) render. we can chunk server-side and lazy-load expansions.

tay: chunking sounds good. concern: how do we preserve "effective permissions" preview used by canaries? we can't lazy-load for rollout checks.

liam: idea: server returns top-level summary + compacted deltas per route. expand on demand. add route-level checksum so UI can show "stale" status.

maria: whats the API contract? sample:
```
GET /v1/tenants/:id/entitlements?mode=compact&limit=100
Response: { summaries: [...], overflow_marker: true }
```

josh: + telemetry: emit `entitlements.compact.fetch` and `entitlements.expand` with duration + item_count.

tay: telemetry needed for quota billing too — chunking changes token counts. we must keep server-side token accounting same as before.

maria: rollout plan: default compact=true for staging; feature flag per-tenant for canary; expose console toggle.

liam: for canary policy check we need always-accurate effective perms. plan: for canary requests, server computes full effective view synchronously; non-canary uses cached compact path.

josh: storage impact: compact summaries compute a bitset + last_updated. cost small.

perm-bot: deploy planned: canary flag `entitlement_compact_v1` set on 3 tenants, scheduled 2025-11-15T10:00Z :rocket:

tay: UX question — show "partial" pill + tooltip? or inline skeleton?

maria: prefer "partial" badge that links to "expand all"; reduces confusion.

liam: also need dashboard metrics: perc of tenants on compact path, avg expand latency, expansion error rate. we'll add to RBAC dashboard.

josh: API note: keep backward compatibility: `mode=full` for existing consumers.

maria: ok. action items:
- josh: api + telemetry (ETA 3d)
- liam: dashboard tiles + feature flag infra (ETA 4d)
- tay: UX copy + partial badge (ETA 2d)
- maria: rollout plan + docs (ETA 1d)

tay: small nit — include trace_id in telemetry for correlating with console logs.

josh: ack. will add `trace_id`. I'll open PR and tag reviewers.

maria: thanks team. ping me when PRs are up.

liam: :thumbsup:
